class.name: NNBehaviour
class.brief_description: A scored option that an [NNAgent] can choose and execute.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNAgent] or [NNBehaviourGroup] to represent one high-level choice the agent can make (such as Patrol, Attack, or Heal). Give each [NNBehaviour] child [NNConsideration] nodes to score how desirable it is right now, and child [NNAction] or [NNActionGroup] nodes (or signal handlers on [signal behaviour_entered] and [signal frame_tick]) to perform the work when selected. You can also set [member on_selected_event] to trigger a transition in a state tree directly on selection. Use [member cooldown_seconds] (for real-time games) or [member cooldown_turns] (for turn-based or evaluation-based cooldowns) to prevent a behaviour from being chosen again immediately after running, and [member can_be_interrupted] to lock in a behaviour until its actions finish.

method.name: get_seconds_since_active
method.description: Returns the seconds of agent time elapsed since this behaviour last ended ([code]0.0[/code] while running, [code]INF[/code] if it has never run). Can be read directly or via [NNTimeSinceBehaviourSensor].

members.member: Optional user-defined ID for identifying this behaviour in scripts without relying on node names.
If [code]false[/code], the owning [NNAgent] will not switch away from this behaviour until its actions finish, an action fails, or [method NNAgent.abort_current_behaviour] is called.
Seconds after selection during which this behaviour scores [code]0.0[/code] and cannot be chosen again. Counts down with agent ticks. Set to [code]0.0[/code] or less to disable.
Number of evaluations after selection during which this behaviour scores [code]0.0[/code]. Set to [code]0[/code] or less to disable.
Child index of the currently active [NNAction] or [NNActionGroup].
Optional state tree event sent when this behaviour is selected. Leave empty to send nothing.
Path to the [NNSTRoot] that receives [member on_selected_event]. Leave empty to target the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot].

signal.name: behaviour_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the owning [NNAgent] selects this behaviour.

signal.name: behaviour_exited
signal.description: Emitted when this behaviour stops running (replaced, completed, failed, or aborted).

signal.name: frame_tick
signal.description: Emitted on every agent step while this behaviour is active.
